# System SMP - Project Description

## 🎯 Short Description
Premium SMP plugin with small caps text, tree felling, custom item displays, and economy-based spawner mining. Fully configurable!

---

## 📝 Full Description

**System SMP** is the ultimate enhancement plugin for survival multiplayer servers. Packed with unique features that will make your server stand out!

### ✨ Key Features

**🔤 Small Caps Text Formatting**
Transform your server's aesthetic with automatic small caps conversion for all text. Every message, GUI, and item name displays in beautiful small caps characters (ʜᴇʟʟᴏ ᴡᴏʀʟᴅ).

**🌲 Tree Feller (Timber)**
Cut down entire trees with one swing! Break the bottom log with an axe and watch the whole tree fall. Perfect for efficient wood gathering while maintaining balance with automatic durability damage.

**💎 Custom Item Displays**
Dropped items show beautiful holograms displaying their name and quantity. No more guessing what items are on the ground! Automatic stacking and merging with updated quantities.

**⛏️ Spawner Pickaxe System**
Revolutionary spawner mining system with:
- Beautiful GUI shop (`/sp`)
- Purchase single-use diamond pickaxes with in-game currency
- Mine any spawner and collect it as an item
- Full Vault economy integration
- Configurable pricing (default: 70,000 coins)

**⚙️ Complete Configuration**
Every feature is fully customizable through `config.yml`:
- Enable/disable features individually
- Customize all colors, messages, and prices
- Reload without restart
- Perfect for any server setup

**🔄 Auto Update Checker**
Built-in Modrinth integration automatically checks for updates and notifies admins when new versions are available.

---

## 🎮 Commands

- `/systemsmp reload` - Reload configuration (Admin only)
- `/systemsmp help` - Show help menu
- `/sp` - Open Spawner Pickaxe shop

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Server Software:** Spigot, Paper, or any fork
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.16 - 1.21+
- **Java:** 8 or higher
- **Dependencies:** 
  - Vault (for economy features)
  - Any economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)

---

## 🚀 Why Choose System SMP?

✅ **Unique Features** - Stand out with small caps text and custom mechanics  
✅ **Economy Integration** - Vault support for balanced gameplay  
✅ **Fully Configurable** - Customize everything to match your server  
✅ **Regular Updates** - Active development and bug fixes  
✅ **Performance Optimized** - Lightweight and efficient  
✅ **1.16-1.21+ Support** - Broad version compatibility

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download the latest version
2. Place in your `plugins/` folder
3. Install Vault and an economy plugin
4. Restart your server
5. Configure `config.yml` to your liking
6. Enjoy!
